fluff.overview: The Word of Blake Militia inherited ComStar's combined-arms organizational philosophy and its Star League-era equipment stocks, fielding infantry formations that ranked among the best equipped in the Inner Sphere during the Jihad. Jump infantry Level I formations gave Militia commanders a vertical mobility option for operations in dense urban environments, where the ability to bypass barricades and reach elevated positions provided tactical flexibility against insurgent forces resisting Protectorate authority. Armed with man-portable flamers that project streams of ignited fuel, these troops carry one of the most psychologically devastating weapons available to conventional infantry, effective at clearing fortified positions and enclosed spaces at the cost of extreme danger to the operator.
